reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

description: A normal-looking weapon animated by magic, flying and attacking with no hand, arm, or visible wielder. One complete sword with blade, guard, grip, and pommel; the weapon itself is the creature. Clean metal blade and simple hilt with minimal decorative marks. Single sword suspended horizontally or diagonally in open air with a clear motion arc.
